# Complete Agent Golden Tasks V0.1

The machine-readable rubric in `MANIFEST.json` maps every master-instruction golden task to a real test/evidence path and an explicit gate result. Existing integration tests create fresh temporary repositories at runtime; expected patches and hidden assertions are not placed in model context.

`PASS_ENGINEERING` proves a deterministic harness/property. `UNSUPPORTED_EXPECTED` proves a stable honest capability boundary. `NOT_RUN` and `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` are non-passing and must remain visible until a credential-authorized live model or a future capability slice closes them.
